environment.description: Node.js 18 application deployed on EC2 instance, connecting directly to PostgreSQL 15 RDS instance. The database role used by the application (product_svc) has SELECT privileges on all tables in the public schema including sensitive tables (users, orders, payment_methods). No network proxy or query inspection layer between application and database. Application exposed via nginx reverse proxy with basic proxy_pass configuration.

config.database: PostgreSQL 15 on RDS, role product_svc with GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public
config.network: Direct TCP connection app->RDS on port 5432 within same VPC
config.proxy: nginx 1.24 with proxy_pass http://localhost:3000, no request filtering
